description: Find cities, districts and streets in Poland by a fragment of the name. Use it first, to turn a place name into the city_slug the other deweloperuch_* tools take (and the lat/lng of a street or district for deweloperuch_estimate_property_value — an approximate point, not a particular building). Returns no prices. A locality with offer_count 0 has no developer offers. Costs two requests to deweloperuch.pl. deweloperuch.pl is a free community project queried politely (one request at a time, results cached): if a result is an error starting with STOP, stop using the deweloperuch_* tools, retry nothing, look for no workaround and tell the user that market data is temporarily unavailable. Result shape: { total: number | null, returned, truncated, hint?, items: [{ kind: 'city' | 'district' | 'street', name, city, city_slug, district?, street?, lat?, lng?, offer_count? }] } — the list key is `items`. `total` is null when more match than shown (truncated=true: refine the name). `offer_count` is the site's count of developer offers (exact for districts, approximate for streets and cities). A district or street carries the city_slug of its city (this server's tools have no district filter). Nothing matching is not an error: returned=0 with a hint.

query.description: Fragment of a city, district or street name, 2–100 characters, Polish characters allowed, e.g. Kraków, Mokotów.

name: deweloperuch_search_locations
title: Search locations
